text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Determined to help Mimi get better,
Misogi, Kyoka and {0} face down
the monster in the labyrinth a second time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミの病気を治すため、地下迷宮を訪れた３人は、
再び魔物と対峙する。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: All right! First, let's take care of its little friends!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
まずは小さい魔物をやっつけてやるー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! You think I'm scared of your silly roars?!
You're gonna pay for last time! Take this! Lemon juice in the eye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへーん！
　そんな声出したって怖くないもんねーっ！
さっきはよくもやってくれたなー！
　くらえ、
目にレモン汁～！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUUOOOOGGHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahah! Didn't like that, did ya?!
Kyoka! They're all yours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはははははー！
　どうだまいったかー！
キョウカ！
　いまがチャンスだよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Misogi! Haaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、ミソギ！
　
やあーっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRUOOOAAAGGGHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: All right! At this rate, I bet we can take down the big guy too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったぁ！
　
この調子であのおっきいやつも倒しちゃお～！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
This is going so much better than last time!
It must be because we're in tune with each other!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
さっきより全然戦いやすい！
ケンカしてもいいことないね！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
You know it! Without all those worries, I'm bursting full of energy!
Let's smash these losers and grab that herb for Mimi!
choice_data_list: So this is the power of friendship!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうそう！
　ミソギもモヤモヤが吹っ飛んで元気百倍だもん！
さっさと倒して
薬草採りに行くぞーっ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Me and Kyoka are the ultimate duo now!
The two of us together can take on just about anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　いまのミソギたちはさいきょーだからね！
どんな困難も
キョウカとなら乗り越えられる！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
{0}, umm... thank you as well.
Thanks to your help, I think we've become closer than ever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんも、
その……
ありがとうございました。
おかげで前よりも
ミソギと仲良くなれた気がします。

text_block_list.name: Alma
text_block_list.text: KKKKRRRSSSKKKRR!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Ahh...! Th-there's power flooding through me!
With this strength...!
Misogi! I'm ready to go any time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃ、
ち、
力が湧いてきます……
これなら！
ミソギ！
　こっちはいつでも大丈夫だよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll stand between you and the monster...
Hey, metalhead! Over here! Are you a monster, or are you a snail?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっけー！
　キョウカとにいちゃんの前に出て……
ほらほーら！
　こっちだよー！
　のろまな魔物！
　のろ魔物ー！

text_block_list.name: Alma
text_block_list.text: GGGHHKKKKKSSS!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Aaand... now! See ya!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いまだー！
　ひょいっと！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff*... I'll trust in Misogi... and summon ice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すーはー、
ミソギを信じて……
氷を、
出す！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: はあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: It worked! The ice reflects its beams! Which means...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！
　光が氷に反射した！
　これなら！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Your own flashy attacks will be your doom!
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分の攻撃で……
やられちゃえー！

text_block_list.name: Alma
text_block_list.text: KKKSSSHRRRKKK!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
A direct hit! I'll keep holding the ice in place,
so Misogi, you finish it off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
直撃！
　私はこのまま氷を維持するから、
ミソギ、
とどめをお願い！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm on it!
Here we go! Misogi Special: Extra-Big Bomb! Taaaake this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
　まかせて！
いっくよ～！
　ミソギ特製、
超特大爆弾！
　とーんでけーっ！

text_block_list.name: Alma
text_block_list.text: KKKSSSHRRRHH...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: We beat it... You're amazing, Misogi! You actually beat it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
倒した……
すごいよミソギ！
　本当に倒しちゃった！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh! I am a total genius, after all!
...Is what I'd like to say, but you're the real genius, Kyoka!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっへへー、
なんたってミソギは天才だから！
……って言いたいけど、
キョウカのおかげだよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Don't be ridiculous. You're the one who came up with the plan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことないよ、
だって作戦を思いついたのはミソギで！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: But you're the one who taught me about reflecting light!
text_block_list.orig_text: 反射の勉強を教えてくれたのはキョウカじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……あー！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh! After our fight, I tried to go back over the stuff you taught me!
I was feeling pretty down, so I didn't last long...
But thank goodness your ice magic worked just the same as a mirror!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへー、
ケンカしちゃった後、
キョウカに教わったこと、
もう一度勉強してたんだ！
　
モヤモヤしててすぐやめちゃったけど！
教えてもらったのは鏡でだったけど、
氷でも成功してよかったー！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
No... Even so, you're the amazing one!
I knew all about reflection, but I couldn't come up with that plan!
That flexible thinking is one of your best points, Misogi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
それでもやっぱりすごいよ！
私は反射のこと知ってても
こんな作戦思いつかなかったし！
そのじゅうなんさが
ミソギのいいところなんだね！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Y-you think so? Eheheh... Talk about a rare compliment!
...Ahh! Wh-what about the herb?
We've gotta get it to Mimi, and quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうかなぁ、
えへへ、
キョウカに褒められちゃった～！
……はっ！
　そ、そうだ薬草！
はやくミミのところに持っていかないと！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
There's an exit right through here!
Misogi, {0}, let's hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
部屋の奥に出口があるよ！
ミソギ、{0}さん、急ごう！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Woooow! It's so pretty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっわぁっ！
　きれーっ！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I never thought the other side of the mountain
would be such a beautiful place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
山を抜けた先に
こんな景色が広がってるなんて……

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot more to the world than mere textbooks
can teach you, my dear Kyoka!
text_block_list.orig_text:
教科書に載ってることが、
全てではないのだよ
キョウカくん……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Where did that come from?
text_block_list.orig_text: なにそれ？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
But... You have a point. I guess you're right, Misogi.
There are more important things than studying textbooks.
Today, you're the one who taught me something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
でもそうだね。
ミソギの言う通りかも……
教科書に載ってることより、
大事なことがあるよね。
私が、
ミソギから教えてもらっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Finally you get it?
Then from now on, we can do less studying and—
text_block_list.orig_text:
やーっとわかったー？
　それじゃあこれからは
勉強もほどほどに――

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: That's a different story! Now, let's find the herb!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは別！
　
ほら、
薬草探そう！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Yep, that's the Kyoka I know...
text_block_list.orig_text: やっぱりキョウカはキョウカだな～

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Now then, where's a herb...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
薬草は……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! This is it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
これだ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: This thing? It just looks like a flower...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ？
　どうみてもお花だけど……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: The leaves and stem have powerful medicinal properties!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この花の葉っぱと
茎の部分が薬草になるんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Then if we take this flower home, we can help Mimi, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあこれを持って帰れば、
ミミの熱は下がるんだね！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Yes... We actually did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ……
私たち、
やったね！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, what a fun day!
It was a pretty long and tricky adventure,
but I couldn't've made it this far without both of you guys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーっ、
楽しかった～！
すっごく長い探検だったけど、
ここまで来れたのは
キョウカとにいちゃんがいたからだね！

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
I only made it here thanks to the two of you, too!
Misogi, you gave me the courage to fight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だって、
ミソギと{0}さんがいたから頑張れたよ！
ミソギが、
私に勇気をくれたから戦えた！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Eheheh... It's kinda embarrassing when you say it like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへっ……
そんな風に言われたことないから照れるなぁ～

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text:
Let's take Mimi too next time...
All of Little Lyrical, exploring together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度はみんな揃って……
リトルリリカルで
探検に行こうね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With their hearts united by a shared goal,
Kyoka and Misogi made their way back to the city
just a little bit more grown-up than they had left it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心を一つにして目的を達成したキョウカとミソギ。
ほんのちょっぴり大人になって、街へと戻るのだった。
